from slug import slugify


def test_spaces_become_hyphens():
    result = slugify("Hello World")
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == "hello-world"
    assert slugify(result) == result


def test_punctuation_is_dropped():
    result = slugify("What's new, in 3.12?")
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == "what-s-new-in-3-12"
    assert slugify(result) == result


def test_accents_are_folded():
    result = slugify("Crème brûlée")
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == "creme-brulee"
    assert slugify(result) == result


def test_surrounding_noise_is_trimmed():
    result = slugify("  --Draft: plan--  ")
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == "draft-plan"
    assert slugify(result) == result


def test_long_titles_are_cut():
    result = slugify("a very long title " * 5)
    assert len(result) <= 40
    assert not result.endswith("-")
